title: Run detail shares progress and selected-step history offline
description: Living ADR-071 acceptance for the approved offline client store. Reuse the isolated one-slot fixture and environment required by command-center-progress-cache.recipe.json. Drive real worker files, the run detail route and selected-step URL through the production gateway/browser. Verify canonical progress, source errors/removals, zero periodic reads during an eleven-second idle window, cold offline saved age, retained old worker/reviewer/selected-step history after slot reuse, and selected-step cold recovery. No UI/cache state injection. Keep this recipe with the feature; native and other families have separate acceptance.

proofTargets.claim: Disconnect preserves the saved checklist and its visible read failure until a successful current read replaces it.
Missing runs fail closed and reused slots preserve old worker, reviewer and selected-step progress without exposing successor bytes.
An actual owned worker checklist edit updates the canonical run row with a newer progress stamp.
A malformed child registry leaves saved counts with a visible read error, then recovers through its owning watcher.
Cold offline startup renders saved checklist counts and age; gateway restart refreshes them before readiness returns.
Observed checklist and acceptance-sidecar removals and recreation reach the canonical progress row without another write or Refresh.
An idle run detail sends no periodic task.progress request during eleven seconds.
Retained selected-step progress renders from its canonical query after slot reuse, cold offline startup and reconnect.

prove.intent: Use one owned scratch worker and real filesystem watchers, then restore exact status bytes and remove every owned fixture.
